    Forbidden bound configurations #

    A configuration (Tab.ConfZ) of a table poset with one zero relation p → m → r of length two, whose dimension count ∑ d_v² + d_p d_r ≤ ∑_{x → y} d_x d_y holds (checked by decide), contradicts finite representation type (Lemmas 8.8 and 8.9).
